title: Steamed Tofu with Polish Dumplings
description: A simple and healthy dish featuring steamed tofu and lightly steamed polish dumplings.

ingredients.name: Polish Dumplings
ingredients.notes: look for vegan or vegetarian option

instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil.
Add the polish dumplings to the pot and cook according to package instructions.
While the dumplings are cooking, place the tofu in a steamer basket over the boiling water.
Steam the tofu for 5-7 minutes, or until it is cooked through.
Remove the tofu and dumplings from the heat and serve with a drizzle of light soy sauce and chopped scallions, if desired.
